nodes.description: Public state variable holding the owner address; written in the constructor and read in the access-control checks of record and revoke.
Constructor that initializes owner from the deployer address (msg.sender).
Public function that records a topic/content pair as an event; guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
Public function that revokes (deletes) a topic by emitting a Revoke event; guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
External caller identity, used as the owner initializer and as the subject of both owner checks.
Topic string parameter of record, only used as indexed event argument.
Content string parameter of record, only used as indexed event argument.
Topic string parameter of revoke, only used as indexed event argument.
Privileged state write owner = msg.sender executed with no prior authorization check; privilege is granted to whoever deploys the contract.

edges.reason: The constructor body unconditionally executes the privileged owner assignment.
External caller identity msg.sender is written directly into the privileged owner state variable.
Constructor initializes the owner state variable.
owner is read in the require(msg.sender == owner) authorization check of record.
msg.sender is compared against owner to gate access to record.
owner is read in the require(msg.sender == owner) authorization check of revoke.
msg.sender is compared against owner to gate access to revoke.
record's topic parameter flows into the Record event emission; no state change or external call.
record's content parameter flows into the Record event emission; no state change or external call.
revoke's topic parameter flows into the Revoke event emission; no state change or external call.
